models_evaluated: 2-tier pediatric inpatient sepsis prediction model (13 variables)

links.outcome: Prospective performance of sepsis model run in silent mode on live EHR data
links.effect: In silent-mode prospective validation in 2019, AUC 0.96 (95% CI 0.95-0.97); Aware tier 100% sensitivity; Alert tier PPV 14% (number needed to alert 7).
links.quote: The model was prospectively validated in the electronic health record in silent mode during 2019.

links.outcome: Threshold selection via precision-recall curve to balance alert burden and sensitivity
links.effect: Two-tier thresholds chosen from precision-recall curve: Alert tier PPV 14% (NNA 7) and Aware tier 100% sensitivity in the validation set.
links.quote: A 2-tier threshold was determined using a precision-recall curve: an "Alert" tier with high positive predictive value to prompt bedside evaluation and an "Aware" tier with high sensitivity to increase situational awareness.

screen.reason: The study evaluates a pediatric sepsis prediction model tested in silent mode deployment within the EHR and evaluates a two-tiered alert/aware threshold selection strategy to balance sensitivity and false-alert burden.

primary.practice: two-tier alert thresholding and silent mode prospective validation
